description: Turn any photo into ASCII art — sample real pixel brightness, tweak width, contrast and character set, then copy or download the text.

faqs.a: Characters are picked by real sampled brightness from your image, so the art genuinely resembles the photo.
faqs.q: Does it actually look like my image?

faqs.a: Standard ramps from sparse to dense, an inverted ramp for dark backgrounds, and a blocks-only set.
Monospace fonts (like the preview) line characters up in a grid. Proportional fonts break the art.
faqs.q: Why does it need a monospace font?

faqs.a: No — conversion happens entirely in your browser.

howto: Set the output width in characters and pick a character ramp.
Adjust brightness/contrast if the art looks flat.
Copy the ASCII art or download it as a .txt file.
title: Image to ASCII Art
